StatementVerdictExplanation

questions.tag: UPI, Payment aggregators and gateways/Number Based
questions.question: A merchant with annual turnover above Rs.20 lakh receives a payment of Rs.2,00,000 through a debit card other than RuPay. What is the maximum MDR the merchant can be charged as per the RBI cap?
questions.solution:
✅ Correct answer: D – Rs.1,000

MDR on debit cards other than RuPay for businesses with annual turnover of Rs.20 lakh or more is capped at 0.9% or Rs.1,000, whichever is lower.

🧮 Calculation

  • 0.9% of Rs.2,00,000 = Rs.1,800
  • Cap = Rs.1,000 → the lower value applies = Rs.1,000.

📌 Key pointers

  • Example in the source: Rs.10,000 × 0.90% = Rs.90.
  • UPI and UPI QR – currently zero MDR; RuPay debit card – zero MDR under prescribed electronic-mode provisions.
  • Small merchant = turnover up to Rs.20 lakh in the previous FY.
  • As of 24 August 2026 merchants are not yet being charged MDR on UPI.

The earlier proposed implementation date was 1 October 2026; the revised effective date is 1 January 2027.

📌 Key pointers

  • Applicable to Commercial Banks, NBFCs, Co-operative Banks and Housing Finance Companies (HFCs).
  • Recovery agents / bank employees can normally contact or visit a borrower or guarantor only between 8:00 am and 7:00 pm.
  • Banks must maintain an up-to-date list of recovery agencies on their website.
  • Borrower/guarantor must be informed about the recovery agency at least one day before the first in-person visit; a change of agency must also be notified.

Consider the following statements about bank locker rules as given in the source:

I. If loss occurs due to bank negligence or employee fraud, the bank's liability is 100 times the annual locker rent.

II. Banks are generally not liable for losses due to Acts of God, provided there is no negligence.

III. If a locker remains inoperative for 7 years and the hirer cannot be located, the bank may break it open.

IV. After the hirer's death, the nominee's claim must be settled within 30 days.
questions.question: Which of the statements given above are correct?

options.E: All I, II, III and IV

questions.solution:
✅ Correct answer: B – Only I, II and III

StatementVerdictExplanation
I✅ TrueLiability = 100× annual rent.
II✅ TrueNatural calamities – generally no liability absent negligence.
